reason: Held after research, with thin evidence. Searches for mid-November 2026 market data returned mostly stale or mirrored pages, so this rests mainly on the packet marks, which are the authority. Recent macro context I could find (September 2026) showed the Fed hiking to 3.75-4% with one more hike signalled and the 10-year above 5%, which supports the existing defensive tilt (XLF, XLE, XLV, SPLV, SPY, plus BTC as an inflation hedge). The book is up +0.40% with every leg inside its stop. Trading would only add churn (2bps per side plus the 0.31bps SEC/TAF on sells) without a dated catalyst I could verify. Flagged: BTC is 2.1% above its -20% stop (mark 68249 vs about 66843 stop). The packet mark conflicts with press reports of BTC near 74K around 11-11, so I did not rely on those reports. The stop handles that leg, and I am not overriding it on unverified prices.
